description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Kog'Maw''' spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location after 0.6 seconds, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area before dealing magic damage to enemies hit and [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealing]] them for 2 seconds. ''Living Artillery's'' damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on target's '''missing''' health)[[Category:Debug]], or instead by [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] 100% if the target is below 40% '''maximum''' health.
description.text: Active: Kog'Maw spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location after 0.6 seconds, granting sight of the area before dealing magic damage to enemies hit and revealing them for 2 seconds. Living Artillery's damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on target's missing health)Category:Debug, or instead by 100% if the target is below 40% maximum health.

description2.raw: '''Kog'Maw''' then generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Living Artillery'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.
description2.text: Kog'Maw then generates a stack of Living Artillery for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.

description3.raw: '''Living Artillery:''' For each stack, ''Living Artillery's'' [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost is increased by 40.
description3.text: Living Artillery: For each stack, Living Artillery's  mana cost is increased by 40.

leveling.raw:
'''Minimum Magic Damage:'''
100 / 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 (+ 75% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 35 / 37.5 / 40 / 42.5 / 45% AP)
'''Maximum Magic Damage:'''
200 / 240 / 280 / 320 / 360 (+ 150% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 70 / 75 / 80 / 85 / 90% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Living Artillery'' will not reveal [[File:Guerrilla Warfare.png|20px|link=Stealth|An icon representing the keyword Stealth]] [[:Stealth|stealthed]] champions. * [[Ping]]ing ''Living Artillery'' will additionally display the remaining time duration of its stacks.
notes.text:
Living Artillery will not reveal stealthed champions.
Pinging Living Artillery will additionally display the remaining time duration of its stacks.
